import sys

def solve(vr, n, k, p):
    EPS = 1e-9
    if p[vr] < EPS:
        return 0.0

    total = 1 << n
    A = [0.0] * total
    B = [0.0] * total
    A[0] = 1.0
    B[0] = 0.0

    for msk in range(1, total):
        if msk & (1 << vr):
            continue
        a = 0.0
        b = 0.0
        same = 0.0
        for i in range(n):
            if i != vr and (msk & (1 << i)):
                same += p[i]
                a += A[msk ^ (1 << i)] * p[i]
                b += B[msk ^ (1 << i)] * p[i]
        inv = 1.0 / (1.0 - same)
        A[msk] = a * inv
        B[msk] = b * inv

    ta = 1.0
    tb = 0.0
    for msk in range(1, total):
        if not (msk & (1 << vr)):
            ta += A[msk]
            tb += B[msk]

    alp = (1.0 - tb) / ta

    ba = 0.0
    bb = 0.0
    for msk in range(total):
        if not (msk & (1 << vr)) and msk.bit_count() >= k:
            ba += A[msk]
            bb += B[msk]

    return 1.0 - (alp * ba + bb)

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    k = int(next(it))
    p = [float(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]

    out = []
    for i in range(n):
        out.append("{:.12f}".format(solve(i, n, k, p)))
    sys.stdout.write(" ".join(out) + "\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
